name: 샬럿

sources.title: 님블뉴런 공식 실험체 스킬: 기적 실현

visual_review: 핑크 머리·부드러운 푸른 눈·보넷과 아르카나 장식 정체성을 유지했습니다. 두 손 기도·앉음·양팔 펼침·희망 전하기·회수 동작과 표정 변화를 확인했습니다. 7번째의 작은 부유는 기적 발동 연출의 일부입니다.
motion_summary: Charlotte long pink hair, gentle blue-gray eyes, white maid/nun-like bonnet and black-white pink costume with luminous blue-white blade-like arcana ornaments from portrait. Official R prepares a miracle then grants brief invulnerability around allies. Animate gentle idle; hands clasp at chest; closes eyes softly; knees and shoulders lower into prayer; opens hands toward sky; blue-white/gold light gathers above palms; rises with open arms and clear face; luminous protective dome outline expands around body, not covering face; hopeful eyes open and hands extend toward right sharing light; arms close gradually; scattered tiny golden-white lights settle; original idle. No staff invented, no angel-human summon, no huge wings added to body. Keep existing arcana ornaments. Actual prayer hands, arm extension and posture movement.
